DECLARE @Marca NVARCHAR(50) = '[TknParams:Marca]';

SELECT

CAST
(
    ROUND
    (
        (
            ISNULL(ngs.Salariu,0)
            *
            ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1)
            *
            (
                1 + ISNULL(s.ProcentLoialitate,0)
            )
        )

        /

        NULLIF
        (
            [Initializari:ZileLucratoare_old(
                Anul='[TknParams:Anul]',
                Luna='[TknParams:Luna]'
            )]
        ,0)

    ,0)

AS DECIMAL(18,2)

) AS MediaZiSalariu

FROM app.Salariat s
INNER JOIN app.NomGrilaSalarizare ngs
    ON ngs.Clasa = s.Clasa
WHERE s.Marca = @Marca
